title: Torta di Mele (Italian Apple Cake)

ingredients.item: Golden Delicious apples (or other eating apples)
Juice and zest of 1 large lemon
g caster sugar, plus extra for sprinkling
g unsalted butter, melted and cooled

steps: Prep. Preheat to 180 °C fan and line a deep 25 cm round tin.
Apples. Peel 4 apples and cut into 5 mm cubes; peel and slice the other 2 into 2 mm half-moons. Keep separate and toss both with lemon juice.
Batter. Whisk eggs and sugar, then milk and melted butter. Sift in flour and baking powder, add lemon zest and vanilla, and mix. Stir in the cubed apples and pour into the tin.
Top. Arrange the slices in an overlapping spiral from the edge to the centre, pressing them in. Sprinkle with sugar if you like.
Bake. Bake on the middle shelf 45–50 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes in the tin; dust with icing sugar.
